properties.description: Checks whether one exact asset.GeoLocation is already assigned to one exact asset.Target for Fabric Interconnect, Unified Edge eCMC, or a supported standalone server. Select an intersight.endpoint target whose default runtime user can read locations and targets. Routing is fail-closed and names must resolve exactly once. A matching AssignedLocation returns idempotent success. If an empty or different assignment would require mutation, the workflow returns 422 before any write because the audited OpenAPI marks asset.Target.AssignedLocation x-createOnly. No update is attempted until Cisco documents a supported assignment operation; candidate Unified Edge and standalone TargetTypes also require live-tenant validation. Generic GET APIs are used because no purpose-built location resolver is available and should be replaced when supported atomics exist.

properties.description: Accepts only Fabric Interconnect, Unified Edge, or Standalone; rejects blank names; escapes apostrophes; and builds the exact current-OpenAPI TargetType allowlist for the selected route.

properties.script:
import json
import sys

targetType = sys.argv[1].strip()
targetName = sys.argv[2].strip()
locationName = sys.argv[3].strip()

routeTargetTypes = {
    "Fabric Interconnect": ["UCSFI", "UCSFIISM"],
    "Unified Edge": ["UCSXECMC"],
    "Standalone": ["IMCM4", "IMCM5", "IMCRack", "UCSC885", "CAI845A", "UCSC890"]
}
routeConfidenceByType = {
    "Fabric Interconnect": "documented",
    "Unified Edge": "candidate-live-validation-required",
    "Standalone": "candidate-live-validation-required"
}
errors = []
if targetType not in routeTargetTypes:
    errors.append("Target Type must be Fabric Interconnect, Unified Edge, or Standalone.")
if not targetName:
    errors.append("Target Name must not be blank.")
if not locationName:
    errors.append("Location Name must not be blank.")

validationStatus = "invalid" if errors else "valid"
validationError = " ".join(errors)
validationResult = json.dumps({"error":"Input validation failed","details":errors}, separators=(",",":"))
normalizedTargetType = targetType
normalizedTargetName = targetName
normalizedLocationName = locationName
escapedTargetName = ""
escapedLocationName = ""
targetTypeClause = ""
allowedTargetTypesJson = ""
routeConfidence = ""

if validationStatus == "valid":
    escapedTargetName = targetName.replace("'", "''")
    escapedLocationName = locationName.replace("'", "''")
    allowedTargetTypes = routeTargetTypes[targetType]
    targetTypeClause = "(" + " or ".join("TargetType eq '" + value + "'" for value in allowedTargetTypes) + ")"
    allowedTargetTypesJson = json.dumps(allowedTargetTypes, separators=(",",":"))
    routeConfidence = routeConfidenceByType[targetType]

properties.description: Requires exactly one result and validates exact Name, URL-safe Moid, ClassId, and ObjectType as asset.GeoLocation.
properties.display_name: Validate exact location cardinality and identity
properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys

expectedName = sys.argv[1]
locationStatus = "invalid"
locationMoid = ""
failureStatusCode = "502"
failureStatusMessage = "Location response was malformed"
failureErrorMessage = "The exact location response could not be validated."
failureResult = json.dumps({"error":failureStatusMessage}, separators=(",",":"))
locationSummary = "{}"
moidPattern = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}$")

try:
    envelope = json.loads(sys.argv[2])
    if not isinstance(envelope, dict):
        raise ValueError("The location response is not a JSON object.")
    results = envelope.get("Results")
    if not isinstance(results, list):
        raise ValueError("The location response does not contain a Results array.")
    if len(results) == 0:
        locationStatus = "missing"
        failureStatusCode = "404"
        failureStatusMessage = "Location was not found"
        failureErrorMessage = "The exact location lookup returned zero matches."
        failureResult = json.dumps({"error":failureStatusMessage,"matchCount":0,"LocationName":expectedName}, separators=(",",":"))
    elif len(results) != 1:
        locationStatus = "cardinality"
        failureStatusCode = "409"
        failureStatusMessage = "Location lookup was ambiguous"
        failureErrorMessage = "The exact location lookup returned " + str(len(results)) + " matches; exactly one is required."
        failureResult = json.dumps({"error":failureStatusMessage,"matchCount":len(results),"LocationName":expectedName}, separators=(",",":"))
    else:
        item = results[0]
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            raise ValueError("The single location result is not an object.")
        locationMoid = str(item.get("Moid","")).strip()
        if not moidPattern.fullmatch(locationMoid):
            raise ValueError("The location result does not contain a URL-safe Moid.")
        if str(item.get("Name","")).strip() != expectedName:
            raise ValueError("The returned location Name does not exactly match the normalized request.")
        if str(item.get("ClassId","")).strip() != "asset.GeoLocation":
            raise ValueError("The returned location ClassId is not asset.GeoLocation.")
        if str(item.get("ObjectType","")).strip() != "asset.GeoLocation":
            raise ValueError("The returned location ObjectType is not asset.GeoLocation.")
        locationStatus = "ready"
        failureStatusCode = ""
        failureStatusMessage = ""
        failureErrorMessage = ""
        failureResult = "{}"
        locationSummary = json.dumps({"Moid":locationMoid,"Name":expectedName,"ClassId":"asset.GeoLocation","ObjectType":"asset.GeoLocation"}, separators=(",",":"))
except Exception as exc:
    locationStatus = "invalid"
    locationMoid = ""
    failureStatusCode = "502"
    failureStatusMessage = "Location response was invalid"
    failureErrorMessage = "The exact location response failed validation: " + str(exc)
    failureResult = json.dumps({"error":failureStatusMessage,"details":failureErrorMessage}, separators=(",",":"))

properties.description: Revalidates the routed target, validates current AssignedLocation, returns same-location idempotency, and prepares a deterministic safety summary when an empty or different assignment would require the unsupported x-createOnly write.
properties.display_name: Validate target and prepare assignment relationship
properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys

expectedName = sys.argv[1]
requestedTargetType = sys.argv[2]
allowedTargetTypes = json.loads(sys.argv[3])
locationMoid = sys.argv[4].strip()
routeConfidence = sys.argv[5]
targetStatus = "invalid"
targetMoid = ""
targetActualType = ""
priorLocationMoid = ""
assignmentMode = ""
patchBody = ""
failureStatusCode = "502"
failureStatusMessage = "Target response was malformed"
failureErrorMessage = "The exact target response could not be validated."
stateResult = json.dumps({"error":failureStatusMessage}, separators=(",",":"))
successResult = "{}"
schemaConflictWarning = "The audited OpenAPI marks asset.Target.AssignedLocation x-createOnly; no mutation is attempted until Cisco documents a supported assignment operation."
moidPattern = re.compile(r"^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}$")
approvedRoutes = {
    "Fabric Interconnect": ["UCSFI", "UCSFIISM"],
    "Unified Edge": ["UCSXECMC"],
    "Standalone": ["IMCM4", "IMCM5", "IMCRack", "UCSC885", "CAI845A", "UCSC890"]
}

try:
    if requestedTargetType not in approvedRoutes or allowedTargetTypes != approvedRoutes[requestedTargetType]:
        raise ValueError("The routed TargetType allowlist is inconsistent.")
    expectedConfidence = "documented" if requestedTargetType == "Fabric Interconnect" else "candidate-live-validation-required"
    if routeConfidence != expectedConfidence:
        raise ValueError("The route confidence token does not match the selected Target Type.")
    if not moidPattern.fullmatch(locationMoid):
        raise ValueError("The resolved location Moid is unusable.")
    envelope = json.loads(sys.argv[6])
    if not isinstance(envelope, dict):
        raise ValueError("The target response is not a JSON object.")
    results = envelope.get("Results")
    if not isinstance(results, list):
        raise ValueError("The target response does not contain a Results array.")
    if len(results) == 0:
        targetStatus = "missing"
        failureStatusCode = "404"
        failureStatusMessage = "Target was not found"
        failureErrorMessage = "The exact target lookup returned zero matches for the selected Target Type."
        stateResult = json.dumps({"error":failureStatusMessage,"matchCount":0,"TargetName":expectedName,"TargetType":requestedTargetType}, separators=(",",":"))
    elif len(results) != 1:
        targetStatus = "cardinality"
        failureStatusCode = "409"
        failureStatusMessage = "Target lookup was ambiguous"
        failureErrorMessage = "The exact name and TargetType lookup returned " + str(len(results)) + " matches; exactly one is required."
        stateResult = json.dumps({"error":failureStatusMessage,"matchCount":len(results),"TargetName":expectedName,"TargetType":requestedTargetType}, separators=(",",":"))
    else:
        item = results[0]
        if not isinstance(item, dict):
            raise ValueError("The single target result is not an object.")
        targetMoid = str(item.get("Moid","")).strip()
        if not moidPattern.fullmatch(targetMoid):
            raise ValueError("The target result does not contain a URL-safe Moid.")
        if str(item.get("Name","")).strip() != expectedName:
            raise ValueError("The returned target Name does not exactly match the normalized request.")
        if str(item.get("ClassId","")).strip() != "asset.Target":
            raise ValueError("The returned target ClassId is not asset.Target.")
        if str(item.get("ObjectType","")).strip() != "asset.Target":
            raise ValueError("The returned target ObjectType is not asset.Target.")
        targetActualType = str(item.get("TargetType","")).strip()
        if targetActualType not in allowedTargetTypes:
            raise ValueError("The returned TargetType is outside the selected route allowlist.")
        assigned = item.get("AssignedLocation")
        if assigned in (None, {}):
            assignmentMode = "assign-empty"
        else:
            if not isinstance(assigned, dict):
                raise ValueError("AssignedLocation is not a relationship object, null, or empty.")
            priorLocationMoid = str(assigned.get("Moid","")).strip()
            priorObjectType = str(assigned.get("ObjectType","")).strip()
            priorClassId = str(assigned.get("ClassId","")).strip()
            if not moidPattern.fullmatch(priorLocationMoid):
                raise ValueError("AssignedLocation contains an unusable Moid.")
            if priorObjectType != "asset.GeoLocation":
                raise ValueError("AssignedLocation ObjectType is not asset.GeoLocation.")
            if priorClassId and priorClassId not in {"mo.MoRef","asset.GeoLocation"}:
                raise ValueError("AssignedLocation ClassId is inconsistent.")
            assignmentMode = "already-assigned" if priorLocationMoid == locationMoid else "replace-different"
        if assignmentMode == "already-assigned":
            targetStatus = "already"
            failureStatusCode = ""
            failureStatusMessage = ""
            failureErrorMessage = ""
            stateResult = json.dumps({"State":"already","TargetMoid":targetMoid,"TargetName":expectedName,"TargetType":targetActualType,"LocationMoid":locationMoid,"AssignmentMode":assignmentMode,"RouteConfidence":routeConfidence}, separators=(",",":"))
            successResult = json.dumps({"updated":False,"idempotent":True,"TargetMoid":targetMoid,"TargetName":expectedName,"TargetType":targetActualType,"LocationMoid":locationMoid,"AssignmentMode":assignmentMode,"RouteConfidence":routeConfidence,"OpenApiCreateOnlyConflictAvoided":True}, separators=(",",":"))
        else:
            relationship = {"ClassId":"mo.MoRef","ObjectType":"asset.GeoLocation","Moid":locationMoid}
            body = {"ClassId":"asset.Target","ObjectType":"asset.Target","AssignedLocation":relationship}
            encoded = json.dumps(body, separators=(",",":"))
            decoded = json.loads(encoded)
            if set(decoded) != {"ClassId","ObjectType","AssignedLocation"}:
                raise ValueError("The PATCH body contains unexpected top-level properties.")
            if decoded["ClassId"] != "asset.Target" or decoded["ObjectType"] != "asset.Target" or decoded["AssignedLocation"] != relationship:
                raise ValueError("The PATCH relationship body failed consistency validation.")
            patchBody = encoded
            targetStatus = "patch"
            failureStatusCode = ""
            failureStatusMessage = ""
            failureErrorMessage = ""
            stateResult = json.dumps({"State":"blocked","MutationRequired":True,"MutationAttempted":False,"GateStatusCode":422,"TargetMoid":targetMoid,"TargetName":expectedName,"TargetType":targetActualType,"LocationMoid":locationMoid,"PriorLocationMoid":priorLocationMoid,"AssignmentMode":assignmentMode,"RouteConfidence":routeConfidence,"SchemaConflictWarning":schemaConflictWarning}, separators=(",",":"))
except Exception as exc:
    targetStatus = "invalid"
    targetMoid = ""
    targetActualType = ""
    priorLocationMoid = ""
    assignmentMode = ""
    patchBody = ""
    failureStatusCode = "502"
    failureStatusMessage = "Target response or assignment state was invalid"
    failureErrorMessage = "The exact target response failed validation: " + str(exc)
    stateResult = json.dumps({"error":failureStatusMessage,"details":failureErrorMessage}, separators=(",",":"))
